cards.t: New Jersey Lifts Coinbase Staking Ban and Drops Penalty
cards.b: New Jersey lifted its staking ban and dropped a $5 million penalty against Coinbase, allowing the restoration of staking access for users in the state.

per.COIN: Staking ban lifted and $5 million penalty dropped in New Jersey.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
cards.missing: The exact timeline for full operational resumption in the state.
